nodes.text: @azfaraisha2 This news highlights the emergence of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in India. It's crucial to understand how HMPV affects treatments and explore preventive measures like vaccination and hygiene practices to safeguard ourselves and our loved ones, especially children.
